entities.summary: Brandon Michael Harry Yip is a Chinese-Canadian former professional ice hockey right wing who played with HC Kunlun Red Star of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL), and earlier also played for the Colorado Avalanche, Nashville Predators, and the Phoenix Coyotes in the National Hockey League. He is of 3/4 Chinese and 1/4 Irish descent.
